preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c.isdigit() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string must contain only lowercase letters and digits.

postconditions.description: The output must be an integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(int(num) for num in ''.join(c if c.isdigit() else ' ' for c in s).split() or [0])
postconditions.description: The output must be the largest number found in the string, or 0 if no numbers are present.
